job.title: 388. Integrity Executive - Safety Advisor
job.description:
Our State Government client is seeking an experienced Safety Advisor to join their team on a temporary assignment.

  • Hourly Rate: Between $79.66 (L6.1) per hour plus super and $87.79 (L6.4) per hour plus super
  • Start Date: ASAP
  • Assignment Length: 6 months
  • Location: Perth CBD

All of our roles are temporary assignments and the hourly rates quoted include a 25% casual loading in lieu of leave entitlements.

In this role as a Safety Advisor your tasks will include:              

  • System Implementation: Help establish and support the rollout of safety systems and processes across a major infrastructure project management environment.
  • Compliance & Assurance: Transition into compliance and assurance activities to ensure the adequate implementation and application of those safety systems.
  • Document Management: Conduct contractor document reviews and draft necessary safety documentation.
  • Inspections & Audits: Perform regular site inspections and contractor audits to evaluate safety adherence.
  • Compliance Reporting: Report on contractor compliance with safety specifications, focusing on public, occupational, construction, traffic and rail safety.

Essential Experience :
 
  • WHS Generalist: Bring comprehensive occupational health and safety expertise to manage diverse workplace risks.
  • Construction Experience: Leverage a background in civils, mechanical, or major construction projects—specifically hospitals, community hubs or correctional facilities.
  • Influence & Relationship Building: Utilise strong interpersonal skills to successfully guide contractors, conduct audits and influence safety behaviours

Onboarding Requirements: To be successful, you will be required to undergo two professional reference checks, provide a National Police Clearance (no older than 3 months), and comply with departmental onboarding processes.

If you have the required experience and are available for this contract, we would love to hear from you. Please reply with your CV or reach out directly to discuss the role in more detail.
